// 00 — about

From the classroom to a workshop of my own.

Studying Mechatronics at Hochschule Niederrhein — a mix of mechanics, electronics, and software. A good fit for anyone who likes seeing things actually move, not just simulated.

So far, most of my time goes into ESP32, from a web-controlled robot car in class to smaller experiments outside of coursework.

Alongside that runs a hobby just as serious: skateboarding — 1 year 3 months in, and I just landed my first kickflip.
